summary: No findings. explain.ts fills authored constant templates (explanations.ts) with engine-derived values only: toFixed(1) percentages, outs.length, seat/rank names from fixed maps keyed by typed enums, and fixed action words. No user, file, network or env input reaches the templates. fillTemplate is a single-pass String.replace, so substituted values are never re-expanded; unknown placeholders throw (fails closed); Object.hasOwn avoids prototype keys. No HTML sinks exist in src (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML), and the substituted values contain no markup characters, so even a future markup sink would not be injectable from this code. No hidden information: postflop text uses equity vs estimated ranges and the hero's own outs count (from PlayerView); preflop text uses hero's hand class and seat; no opponent hole cards are referenced. Fully deterministic (no randomness, no time). No new dependencies, nothing logged.
